title: RELAY golden vector distribution manifest
description: spec/vectors/vectors_manifest.json — pins the canonical golden vector distribution (spec §15.8, Requirement 16).

vectors_version.description: The RELAY spec version (spec/version.json) that last changed the vector set.

name.description: Vector name relative to spec/vectors/, .json suffix stripped, e.g. "can-standard-frame" or "errors/lin-diagnostic-wrong-checksum".

sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the vector file's raw bytes.

vectors.description: One entry per file under spec/vectors/ (including spec/vectors/errors/).
